answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the willow queue while genuine members promoted earlier continues earning. The zenith index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1041 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the sparrow. The deposit is 50 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
